### Before

Dear Mr. Fish,

If you went to the clouds for vaction,

come back quick.

if you are sleeping for extra hours,

WAKE UP!

You have been sleeping for exactly 2 days and 2 hours,

which makes you very fishy

### After

Sorry, I ran out of fish food.
